posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
if you use the default EnemyBook.js than there is no scale option.
but the size used in battle.
so you need to either modify or make bigger enemies.
if using sideview battlers for example, a small edit to target the frontview battlers
for bigger size to show.
but if you use a different enemybook/bestiary, we need to know to guide you.
